verdict.rationale: Runloop documents one-command fan-out: a single CLI benchmark job provisions many devboxes, runs the agents, scores the results and aggregates outputs, and can compare multiple agents side-by-side. It also claims 10k+ parallel sandboxes and supports snapshot-based fan-out. These are bulk executions within benchmarking rather than general bulk operations on resources. missing for 10: documented general batch or bulk API/CLI operations across arbitrary devboxes or resources (e.g., bulk shutdown, delete, or execute), bulk actions beyond benchmark jobs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
